limits: Literal module-attribute assignments outside quote blocks. Excludes compiler/docs/type attributes. Numeric evaluation is restricted to literal +, -, *, div; all other expressions remain symbolic. No macro expansion, inferred units, transitive values, inline literal census or semantic equivalence claimed. Equal numbers can have different units/owners. Equal expressions can resolve aliases or attributes differently. Candidate groups are not findings or savings. Numeric and symbolic assignments are disjoint; not all inline constants are captured.
